title: Graph
description: Force-directed similarity graph payload: the input node plus its retrieved candidate nodes, with edges weighted by similarity. Self-contained - the frontend renders this directly with no ML logic (Task 3.3).

id.description: Unique within this graph. The input node's id is always 'input'; candidate node ids match Candidate.id.

label.description: Short display label, e.g. a truncated prompt or 'Input'.

prompt.description: Full prompt text shown on node click. Null for the input node when modality is image.

style_cluster.description: Optional style-tag cluster label used for visual grouping in the force-directed layout.

weight.description: Similarity in [0, 1]; the frontend maps this to edge length/strength (1 - weight).
